content: extractCoverageScene uses forEachProjectMesh to iterate visible non-helper non-sun_marker objects, creates Object3D roots, extracts triangles-only THREE.Mesh instances with position attributes, visits each mesh indicating whether the object is a floor, and disposes roots after traversal; work is chunked via yieldToMainThread to avoid monopolizing the browser event loop. copyPositionAttribute copies position data in chunks of COPY_CHUNK_VALUES values for unnormalized non-interleaved itemSize-3 attributes, otherwise copies per vertex in chunks of COPY_CHUNK_VALUES/3 vertices, yielding to the main thread between chunks.

items.text: copyPositionAttribute handles copying position buffer data in two paths: a direct typed-array copy path for simple unnormalized non-interleaved 3-component attributes using COPY_CHUNK_VALUES-sized ranges, and a per-vertex accessor path for other attributes using chunks of COPY_CHUNK_VALUES/3 vertices, with main-thread yields between chunks in both paths.
